pr create --base main --head fix/deploy-sh-restart-status --title tools/deploy.sh: report fruitd restart failure and print active state --body tools/deploy.sh prints "fruitd restarted OK" unconditionally, even when `systemctl restart fruitd` fails.

This change checks the restart's exit status:
- on failure it prints an error to stderr and exits 1;
- on success it still prints the OK line, then prints the service's real active state via `systemctl is-active fruitd` (which also leaves the script non-zero if fruitd somehow is not active after a successful restart).

Verified locally by stubbing `systemctl` on PATH: restart-success prints "fruitd restarted OK" + "active" with exit 0; restart-failure prints the error and exits 1 without the OK line. The real check can only happen on the pantry server (Debian/systemd).

pr create --base main --head fix/readme-repository-typo --title README: fix "repositoriy's" typo in first paragraph --body Fixes the spelling in the README's first paragraph: "run by the repositoriy's owner" -> "run by the repository's owner". One-word change, nothing else touched.
